description_en: A long cylindrical woven brush travel case with removable matching cap, textile lining and leather wrist loop. Canonical front: the cap joint and small leather pull tab. Side view: a slender cylinder with reinforced end rims. Rear view: the wrist-loop attachment seam and circular base. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE original photorealistic Vietnamese rattan/bamboo studio catalog product. Subject: A long cylindrical woven brush travel case with removable matching cap, textile lining and leather wrist loop. Canonical front: the cap joint and small leather pull tab. Side view: a slender cylinder with reinforced end rims. Rear view: the wrist-loop attachment seam and circular base. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.. Style Modern: clean contemporary geometry. Relative size compact within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: open square lattice made from wider flat strips. Finish: cinnabar red lacquer retaining clearly visible woven strip intersections. Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, stable wood/bamboo frame and only specified plain secondary materials. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact straight-on FRONT ELEVATION at azimuth zero, directly facing its described front feature, level with product center. No three-quarter or overhead angle. This is the canonical FRONT image for subsequent views of the same design. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions.

visual_review.method: manual comparison of canonical front and three-view review sheet
